import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Scatter plot: Price vs Megapixels with ISO as size
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                      s=df['max_iso']/500, alpha=0.7, 
                      c=df['model_year'], cmap='viridis')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels (Size = Max ISO, Color = Year)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Model Year')

# 2. Bar plot: Average price by brand
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
brand_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values()
brand_price.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(brand_price)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Bar plot: Camera count by body type
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
body_type_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
body_type_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(body_type_counts)))
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.set_title('Camera Distribution by Body Type')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Box plot: Price distribution by sensor type
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Sensor Type')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax4.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Line plot: Camera specs evolution over years
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
years_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
ax5.plot(years_sorted['model_year'], years_sorted['megapixels'], 
         marker='o', label='Megapixels', linewidth=2)
ax5.plot(years_sorted['model_year'], years_sorted['max_iso']/1000, 
         marker='s', label='Max ISO (thousands)', linewidth=2)
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax5.set_ylabel('Value')
ax5.set_title('Camera Specs Evolution Over Years')
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Scatter plot: Weight vs Price colored by body type
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
for body_type in df['body_type'].unique():
    subset = df[df['body_type'] == body_type]
    ax6.scatter(subset['weight_grams'], subset['price_usd'], 
                label=body_type, s=100, alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)')
ax6.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax6.set_title('Weight vs Price by Body Type')
ax6.legend()

# 7. Pie chart: Distribution of video 4k capability
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
video_counts = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
ax7.pie(video_counts.values, labels=['No 4K', 'Has 4K'], 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax7.set_title('4K Video Capability Distribution')

# 8. Heatmap: Correlation matrix of numerical features
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
numerical_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax8)
ax8.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numerical Features')

# 9. Bar plot: Lens mount distribution
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
lens_counts = df['lens_mount'].value_counts()
lens_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax9, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(lens_counts)))
ax9.set_xlabel('Lens Mount')
ax9.set_ylabel('Count')
ax9.set_title('Lens Mount Distribution')
ax9.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
